title: Successor reader is a prefix inverse
statement: For every bound $n\in\mathbb N$, optional state $s\in\{	ext{none}\}\cup\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and bit string $x$, the successor-state reader applied to the encoding of $s$ followed by $x$ succeeds and returns $(s,x)$. Here the encoding is $0$ for no state and, for state $i$, a $1$ followed by $i$ ones and a $0$.
hypotheses_covered: An optional state s in Fin n
replaced:
For a bound $n$, a successor-state field $s$ (either halt or a live state
$i < n$), and any bit string $x$: the successor-state reader with bound $n$,
applied to the encoding of $s$ (a single $0$ for halt; a $1$ followed by the
unary code of $i$ for a live state) followed by $x$, succeeds and returns
$(s, x)$.
